senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) letter, document, book.
units: Eduy. I, 12, a. fr. ס׳ כתובה the formula of a Kethubah.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:16:2">Y. Sot. IX, end, 24ᶜ</cite> <he>משמת ר״א נגנז ס׳ החכמה</he> with the death of R. El. a book of wisdom disappeared; Bab.
<cite ref="Sotah 49b:16">Sot. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>נגנז ס׳ תורה</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:3">Tosef. ib. XV, 3</cite> <he>בטל ס׳ תורה</he>.
Gen. R. s. 24 סִפְרוֹ של אה״ר the book of Adam (the destinies of humanity); Ex. R. s. 40; Lev. R. s. 15 beg.; a. fr.—Esp. a Biblical book.

B. Bath. 15ᵃ ירמיה כתב ספרו וס׳ מלכים וכ׳ Jeremiah wrote his book (the prophecies of Jerem.) and the Book of Kings and the Lamentations. Ib. 14ᵇ משה כתב ספרו וכ׳ Moses wrote his own book, and the Section of Balaam (the chapters on B., Num. XXII, 2—XXIV, 25) and Job; Y. Sot. V, end, 20ᵈ; a. v. fr.—ס׳ תורה (abbrev. ס״ת) (or ס׳ only) the Pentateuch in a scroll.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:6">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>כרכוהו בס״ת וכ׳</he> they wrapped him up in the scroll &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 116a:5">Sabb. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>ס״ת שנמחק</he> a scroll of the Pentateuch the writing of which is effaced; <cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 3:5">Yad. III, 5</cite> <he>ס׳ שנמחק</he>; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:6">Kel. XV, 6</cite>, a. e. <he>ס׳ העזרה</he> the Pentateuch kept in the Temple court, v. <cite ref="P00430"><he>עֲזָרָה</he></cite>.—<he>ס׳ הוא</he>, <he>ס׳ זעטוטים</he> &c., v. respective determinants.—<cite ref="O00968"><he>בֵּית סֵ׳</he></cite>, <he>בֵּית הַסֵּ׳</he> the school in which the Bible is taught, secondary school, contrad. to <he>בית תלמוד</he> Talmud school.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 3:3:8">Y. Maasr. III, 50ᵈ</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01417"><he>סַפָּר</he></cite> 1.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:9">Midr. Till. to XCII, 16</cite> <he>שתולים</he> … <he>אלו התינוקות שבבית הס׳</he> ‘planted in the house of the Lord’ (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:14">ib. 14</cite>), that means the children at school; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סְפָרִים</he>, constr. <he>סִפְרֵי</he>, <cite ref="O01382"><he>סִיפְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 41:7">Ex. R. s. 41</cite> <he>זריז בכ״ד ס׳</he> well-versed in the twenty-four books of the Scripture.
<cite ref="Shabbat 116a:3">Sabb. 116ᵃ</cite> (<he>ס׳ צדוקים</he>) <he>ס׳ מינים</he> heretical books, v. <cite ref="M01208"><he>מִין</he> III</cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 68a:5">Snh. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>שתי … כשני ס׳ תורה וכ׳</he> my two arms which are like two rolled up scrolls of the Torah, a. v. fr.—Ch. <cite ref="O01426"><he>סִפְרָא</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="O01422"><he>סֵפֶר</he></cite>.
